meta.name: five-punishments-judicial-procedure
meta.description: Use when adjudicating criminal cases or determining punishments under the five-tier system. Applies graduated verification from 五刑 to 五罚 to 五过, with doubt-based amnesty protocols and fine schedules for 3,000 categorized crimes.

copy.tagline: 按五刑体系裁决刑事案件并确定刑罚
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据五刑制度审理案件或确定处罚
copy.tagline_en: Adjudicate criminal cases and determine punishments under the five-tier system
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to adjudicate cases or determine punishments under the five-punishments system

howto.what: Claude会按照五刑→五罚→五过的逐级验证流程审理刑事案件，证据不足时触发赦免程序，并根据罚金表确定罚金。
howto.when: 当你要求审理刑事案件或确定五刑制度下的惩罚时触发。

say.text: 审理一起盗窃案，按五刑程序定罪。
say.note: Claude会依次验证五刑、五罚、五过。

say.text: 被告对判决有疑问，申请赦免。
say.note: Claude会审查证据并判断是否适用赦免。
Claude会根据刑种查找对应的罚金率。

howto.what_en: Claude follows a graduated verification process from Five Punishments to Five Fines to Five Mitigations when adjudicating criminal cases. It triggers amnesty when doubt exists and applies fine schedules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to adjudicate a criminal case or determine punishments under the five-tier system.

say_en.text: Try a theft case with the five-punishment procedure.
say_en.note: Claude will verify punishments step by step.

say_en.text: The defendant questions the verdict, request amnesty.
say_en.note: Claude will review evidence for amnesty eligibility.

say_en.text: Calculate the fine for this case.
say_en.note: Claude looks up the fine rate for the punishment type.
